task: Tonga royal identity and likeness review

scope.meaning: Codex evidence review and proposed identity bindings. Root integration owns runtime changes and generated-art review; this file grants no office eligibility or forced succession.

provenance.archive_requests: Exactly two new original-body retrievals, successful HTTP 200, 45 seconds apart. Both body hashes match the earlier recorded originals. Archive lane returned to root after completion.
provenance.hash_meaning: SHA-256 of retained original body bytes; inherited claim hashes below refer to prior structured claims and are not source-body hashes.

born.basis: Preserved existing registry fact; not independently re-established here.

office.basis: Saved opening start preserved. End is inherited reviewed Tonga-local death date, not newly retrieved in this subtask.

existing_1990.credit: Spheres cartoon adaptation generated with OpenAI image_gen from Comet Photo AG (Zurich) / ETH Library, Image Archive, Com_LC1500-0777-001 (1985), CC BY-SA 4.0. Cartoon adaptation and any copyrightable contributions are also offered under CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Changed to full-body cartoon, simplified shapes and near-1990 age treatment. No endorsement implied.
existing_1990.era_note: Near-1990 artistic appearance informed by an inspected 1985 portrait; no exact 1990 photograph established. Conservatively displayed from 1 January 1990 up to but not including 1 January 1991. Standing body, trousers and shoes are artistic extensions of the observed civilian suit. This artwork does not establish reign, party membership, candidate eligibility or later appearance.

identity_source.credit: Comet Photo AG (Zurich) / ETH Library, Image Archive, Com_LC1500-0777-001; photograph dated 1985, provided by ETH Library through Wikimedia Commons. Retained as the unchanged 1280-pixel JPEG preview of the archive TIFF.

existing_1990.generation_record: Built-in image_gen, 13 September 2026. Exact prompt, input roles, original output location, file hashes, source rights and Codex visual review retained in tools/avatars/person-prompts/taufaahau-tupou-iv-cartoon-1990-v1.json.

review.reviewer: Codex visual QA; personally inspected source photograph, established style anchor and generated result. Artistic interpretation; no human or user approval claimed.

art.decision: Preserve the existing exclusive 1991-01-01 end. No newly dated later-era licensed reference established.
art.later_variant_limit: Any newly generated later variant based on the 1985 source must explicitly be an age extrapolation, receive a separate art review and receipt, and must not pretend that the old 1990 acceptance covers it.

aliases: Siaosi Tāufaʻāhau Manumataongo Tukuʻaho Tupou V
identities.decision: Resolve the held alias binding: the Czech MFA explicitly equates the distinguishing full name with George Tupou V, supplementing the prior PMO proclamation’s Crown Prince bridge. Do not create another permanent King George V ID.

office.start_basis: Inherited prior review of PMO death and proclamation records; no new Archive request for those originals in this subtask.
office.end_basis: Newly retained and visually reviewed Gazette No. 8 of 2012.
office.ceremonies_are_separate: 2008 coronation is not accession; preserved opening Crown Prince since 1966-05-04 is not changed.

identities.art_era_proposal: One near-1990 variant using 1997 plus 1979 context, and one later royal variant using 2011; artistically interpret intermediate ages without alleging exact-date photographs.

identities.decision: Resolve the held PM-to-King binding through the original 2006 PMO article and 2012 Gazette proclamation. The same permanent ID carries both PM and King roles.

offices.start_basis: Explicit commencement in the newly retained 2002 PMO original.
offices.end_basis: Resignation acceptance date inherited from prior reviewed PMO records, not newly fetched here.

offices.basis: Gazette No. 8 establishes predecessor death; Gazette No. 9 states devolution by that death and explicitly names Tupoutoʻa Lavaka as Tupou VI.
offices.continuity_limit: No end before the fixed cutoff established. Latest attestation already in the preparation packet is 2025-12-18; a null end is not a promise of reign through 2035.

crown_prince_vesting.basis: PMO publication 2006-09-28; do not derive a day from yesterday.

identities.art_era_proposal: Early PM appearance using dated 2000 image plus undated facial supplement; later King appearance using 2019. A post-cutoff older variant, if used, is explicit fictional age interpretation.

identities.name: Crown Prince Tupouto'a 'Ulukalala
identities.full_name: Siaosi Manumataongo ʻAlaivahamamaʻo ʻAhoʻeitu Konstantin Tukuʻaho
identities.decision: Royal Palace full name, parentage and birthday establish a separate person. The 2006 PMO article identifies the father’s eldest son receiving the ʻUlukalala title. He must not merge with the existing 1990 heir just because both hold Tupoutoʻa or share Siaosi Manumataongo.

crown_prince.limit: Exact title vesting date not established here.

identities.post_cutoff: No invented accession date, death date, regnal name or guaranteed succession through 2035. Any later role is conditional campaign fiction.

findings: Printed page 7, section 2.3 explicitly links Siaosi Tāufaʻāhau Manumataongo Tukuʻaho Tupou V with the English name George Tupou V.
The full name matches the distinguishing saved 1990 heir name, providing the missing identity bridge beyond the inherited Crown Prince title.
excluded_claims: Do not import the report’s coronation date or family/children claims; they were not accepted in this review.

sources.kind: Contemporaneous Tongan PMO original preserved by Internet Archive
findings: Names Prince ʻUlukalala Lavaka Ata as Prime Minister.
Explicit commencement date 3 January 2000; birth date 12 July 1959.
sources.photo_rights: Embedded photograph was not downloaded or treated as licensed.

sources.kind: Contemporaneous Tongan PMO original preserved by Internet Archive
findings: 28 September 2006 publication explicitly identifies the former Prince ʻUlukalala Lavaka Ata as Crown Prince Tupoutoʻa Lavaka.
Identifies his eldest son by the long name Jiaosi Manumataongo Alaivahamamaʻo ʻAho ʻEitu Konstantin Tukuʻaho and says that son receives the title ʻUlukalala.
sources.limits: The vesting is described as yesterday; no exact day is derived. The source’s Jiaosi spelling is retained as a source spelling, not a new person or a link to George V.

sources.kind: Tonga Government Gazette Extraordinary No. 8 of 2012
findings: George Tupou V died on 18 March 2012, at 15:58 Hong Kong time / 20:58 Tonga time.
Publication date 19 March 2012 is distinct from death date.

sources.kind: Tonga Government Gazette Extraordinary No. 9 of 2012
findings: Explicitly links Crown Prince Tupoutoʻa Lavaka to King Tupou VI.
States that the Crown devolves upon him by George Tupou V’s decease; proclamation signed 19 March 2012.

sources.kind: Royal Palace of Tonga family history
findings: Identifies King Tupou VI’s son Tupoutoʻa ʻUlukalala by the full name Siaosi Manumataongo ʻAlaivahamamaʻo ʻAhoʻeitu Konstantin Tukuʻaho.
Gives his birth as 17 September 1985 in Nukuʻalofa.
sources.limits: Undated live page retrieved after the fixed cutoff; used for identity and historic birth facts. Pre-cutoff Crown Prince attestations come from dated 2012 and 2022 photographs, not a claim about present status at retrieval.

sources.kind: Taiwan MOFA Government Website Open Information Announcement
findings: Allows reproduction and adaptation, including commercial reuse, with source credit, subject to stated third-party exclusions.
sources.limits: Licence evaluated with the retained Commons attribution-only tag. Normal certificate-chain verification retained; Python strict X.509 extension enforcement was relaxed for the certificate’s missing SubjectKeyIdentifier.
